sources.quote: Subscriptions you create through the API now default to [flexible billing mode](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/billing-mode.md). To use `classic`, set the `billing_mode.type` parameter to `classic`.

When a customer schedules a cancellation through the [Customer Portal](https://docs.stripe.com/customer-management/cancellation-page.md), flexible billing mode uses `cancel_at` directly rather than `cancel_at_period_end`.
- If the request API version is [2025-09-30.clover](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog.md#2025-09-30.clover) or newer, the default is `flexible` billing mode.

effect: New subscriptions default to flexible billing. Free-to-paid upgrades can defer the invoice; portal cancellations use cancel_at. Existing subscriptions keep their billing mode.

keepOld.edit: billing_mode: { type: 'classic' } at the site's specified API parameter path; decision-only sites must not be edited

adopt: use flexible billing only after reviewing free-to-paid invoice timing and portal cancellation readers. Existing flexible subscriptions cannot be migrated back to classic; subscriptions.update and portal session creation have no general preserving billing_mode edit
